During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''battle''' was fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vendrak V]]. [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] planted information that a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] on Vendrak V contained weapons that would be useful to the Rebellion. Two squads were dispatched to secure the weapons, but were caught in an Imperial trap.
